In Godot, open a pack's project.godot to try its demo, or copy its addons folder into your project;
the packs' addons sit side by side in one project. Each pack's LICENSE.txt is its licence.

Want more? Godot FX Collection has every pack whole: https://heyheythere.itch.io/godot-fx-collection
